Profile

I work at the intersection of design, analysis, and the shop floor. Over the past three years I've moved between manufacturing engineering, structural analysis, and systems design roles — reducing cleanroom cycle times for biomedical device production at Kardium, validating fatigue life on rail hardware for freight and transit systems at LB Foster, and supporting brake-hardware procurement on Vancouver's Canada Line at AtkinsRéalis.

Outside of internships, I lead the composites program for UBC's electric motorcycle team, and I've used convolutional neural networks to predict the stiffness of 3D-printed lattice structures from their print geometry alone. I'm drawn to problems that require both a spreadsheet and a pair of safety glasses.

Projects

Manufacturing & CAM

CAM design for a MacBook chassis

Designed a high-volume production fixture in Siemens NX for a thin-walled aluminum MacBook keyboard chassis, accounting for 5-axis access and part stability, then built out a full CAM process — roughing and finishing toolpaths, tooling selection, and feed rates — for a 5-axis HAAS UMC-style mill.

Delivered a fully documented NX package — fixture, tool assemblies, CAM operations, and machine-ready G-code — and flagged design changes that removed non-machinable features.

Skills: Siemens NX 5-axis CAM Fixture design Tooling selection

Analysis & design — LB Foster

Train hardware for freight and transit

Custom mounting hardware for train-mounted friction management systems, validated against GM/RT 2100, BS 7608, and IEC 61373 using FEA for proof loading, fatigue, and modal analysis, then assessed further under random vibration and shock in CAE Fatigue.

Increased component fatigue life by 33% through simulation-driven design refinement, and deployed 9+ additively manufactured alignment tools into freight and transit service across North America and Asia.

Skills: FEA SolidWorks GD&T 3D printing

Machine Design

Drift Trike

Working within an 8-person team, helped design and analyze a chain-driven drivetrain for a 3 hp gas-powered drift trike, building Excel and Python tools to iterate operating conditions and select sprockets, shaft features, and tapered roller bearings from Timken catalogues.

Machined and installed the drivetrain shaft myself, taking the build from concept to a working prototype and presenting the final report to Mechanical Engineering faculty.

Skills: Python Excel Bearing selection Machining

Computation & materials

Predicting stiffness from print geometry

Trained CNN and ANN regression models in Keras to predict the stiffness of FDM-printed gyroid beams directly from their sliced print-layer images or G-code, correlating results against 72 physical 3-point bending tests and using PCA to cut the feature set to 117 inputs.

Reached R² values above 0.8 and built a model that estimates stiffness straight from an image or G-code file — no physical test required, and faster iteration on future lattice designs.

Skills: Python Keras CNN / ANN PCA

Composites & fabrication — UBC ThunderBikes

Bodywork for an electric race motorcycle

Photogrammetry-scanned the original motorcycle in RealityCapture and Blender, reconstructed and surface-modelled the fairings, windshield, and gas tank in SolidWorks for fit and manufacturability, then fabricated the parts in carbon fibre and fibreglass with wet-layup and vacuum infusion.

Lower porosity and a cleaner surface finish fed straight into CFD analysis used to redesign the mounting brackets, supporting both weight reduction and better aerodynamics.

Skills: Photogrammetry SolidWorks Composite layup Vacuum infusion

Systems engineering

A two-stage launch vehicle for a mock spacecraft

Designed a mock spacecraft to maximize dwell time across a 2D model of a planet's gravity while minimizing mass and cost, then built and competed with an Arduino-controlled two-stage launch vehicle with a spring-powered ball launcher as its secondary stage — timing and angle tuned in SolidWorks Motion Analysis and MSC ADAMS.

Delivered a top-scoring report among 20 teams, and the only one to complete the full two-stage launch on all three allowed attempts.

Skills: SolidWorks Motion MSC ADAMS Arduino BOM & costing
